newsitem.title: BRAZIL: FOREIGN INFLOWS INTO BRAZIL BOLSAS UP IN JULY - CVM.
newsitem.headline: FOREIGN INFLOWS INTO BRAZIL BOLSAS UP IN JULY - CVM.

text.p: Net foreign capital inflows to Brazilian stock exchanges under Annex Four rules totalled $763.2 million in July, up from $555.32 million in the prior month, Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) said.
Foreign buys were $3.851 billion while foreign sales reached $3.08 billion, the CVM said in a statement.
July net foreign inflows were the highest monthly total since January, when the figure reached $949 million.
In the first seven months, net foreign investment amounted to $4.728 billion, more than all of last year's total foreign investment of $3.593 billion, it said.
Annex Four regulates foreign investment in Brazilian stocks, debentures and privatization bonds.
